description:
One graph spec combining a historian with alarms (scada), vibration monitoring (vibration),
        visual inspection (visual) and a digital twin (twin) for one asset, with its dashboards, built
        from validated native nodes. Advisory only: it never commands equipment. Next:
        review_industrial_solution, then create_graph.
        Example: compose_industrial_solution(requirements={"name": "Pump 3", "asset_path": "Plant/Line1/Pump3", "modules": ["scada", "vibration"]}).

requirements.description: What the solution needs: name, asset_path (e.g. Plant/Line1/Pump3), modules (any of twin, vibration, visual, scada) and the vibration parameters sample_rate_hz, shaft_rpm and window_size.
